fields.Name: T124 - Admin Roles Management
fields.Description: Verifies the Admin app's Identity & Access > Roles sub-section loads and displays a grid of role records without errors.

InputDefinition.goal: Switch to the Admin app using the application switcher dropdown next to the logo (NOT the Ctrl+K search box). Open the 'Identity & Access' section, then in its left sub-navigation click the 'Roles' sub-section. The success state is a grid of role records (such as UI, Integration, and Developer roles) displayed in the main panel. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained env - wait for the grid to populate, do not navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: The Admin app is active with the Identity & Access section open and the Roles sub-section selected in the left sub-navigation
A grid of role records is visible in the main panel showing multiple rows
Role names such as UI, Integration, or Developer appear in the grid
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
